summary_1line: Rama slays Ravana with the Brahma weapon, Sita proves her purity before the gods, and Rama is reunited with her as the celestials celebrate.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama releases the Brahma weapon from his drawn bow as Ravana and his chariot erupt in a blazing cosmic fire.
Sita, tearful and disheveled, collapses like a felled plantain tree after Rama harshly rejects her before the silent monkey army.
The sky fills with gods on radiant chariots as Sita stands before Rama invoking the elements to testify to her purity.
